_comment: Copy to .mcp.json (git-ignored) and keep the servers you use. Placeholders in <angle brackets> are yours to fill; never commit a filled-in copy. On Windows the npx servers are launched through cmd /c; on Linux/macOS use "command": "npx" with "args": ["-y", ...].

args: <absolute path to the directory holding your bamdude checkout>

sqlite._comment: Read-only exploration of a SQLite data directory; irrelevant on PostgreSQL. Point it at a COPY of data/bamdude.db, never at the database a running BamDude is using.

vault._comment: The bamdude.obsidian knowledge base, served from inside Obsidian by the 'Semantic Notes Vault MCP' community plugin (semantic-vault-mcp). Enable the plugin, copy its port and API key here.

headers.Authorization: Bearer <API key from the plugin settings>
